name: Square Bar
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Square Bar in Tirol!**

Discover the heart of **Tirol**’s vibrant nightlife in our cozy yet stylish **Square Bar**—right in the center of **Innsbruck**’s lively **Herz-Jesu-Kirche** square. Whether you’re craving a cold **Tiroler Bier**, a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner**, or a shot of **Obstler**, our expert bartenders craft the perfect drink for every mood.

After a day of hiking in the **Zillertal Alps** or exploring **Innsbruck**’s historic old town, unwind with friends in our relaxed yet energetic atmosphere. Try our famous **Kaiserschmarrn** brunch or savor a hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**—local flavors that warm the soul.

Live music, DJ sets, and occasional open-air events make every visit unforgettable. Whether you’re here for a quick aperitif or a night of dancing, the **Square Bar** is your go-to spot in **Tirol**’s capital.

**Come as you are—stay as long as you like!** 🍻✨
